actualCause: The command script issued `open north_gate` while `north_gate.access` was still in its initial `locked` machine state. `nomos.run` executes requests in order and stops at the first rejection; the first request (`ignite north_gate`) committed (cold->burning plus the designed causal fire event intact->destroyed, tick 1) but left `north_gate.access` unchanged at `locked`. The second request resolved to `north_gate.access.open`, whose only compiled transition is `closed -> open`; the machine was `locked`, so the commit legality check rejected it with EK0804 (`north_gate.access.open` is illegal while the machine is `locked`). The script never issued the required prerequisite `unlock north_gate`, the only transition out of `locked`, and that unlock is credential-gated: `north_gate` is bound to catalog value `credential/gaoler_key` and the compiled unlock requirement is `{"credential":"credential/gaoler_key","kind":"credential"}`, which the command-script grammar spells `unlock north_gate with credential/gaoler_key`.
causalChain: Compiled package `input/world` (package digest fd2dca0e9cf8b352a474c414291d9a96c19758f518c1cf70fd4fa46293710440, semantics 0cdb454b...) derives initial runtime state: north_gate.access=locked, north_gate.combustion=cold, north_gate.integrity=intact, north_gate.ward=sealed, brazier_02.emission=lit (initial-state.json, state hash fa7247d1...).

World IR fixes the access machine transitions: unlock is the only transition from `locked` (to `closed`), and open is defined only from `closed` (to `open`); close is only from `open`. north_gate carries entity credential credential/gaoler_key.

Request 1 `ignite north_gate` resolves to north_gate.combustion.ignite and commits: combustion cold->burning; the compiled causal interaction on_enter(burning) fires apply_damage(amount=2, channel=fire) on north_gate.integrity, moving integrity intact->destroyed (receipt tick 1, state hash b40b53f9...). north_gate.access is untouched and remains `locked`.

Request 2 `open north_gate` resolves to north_gate.access.open. The legality check requires the machine's current state to equal the transition source (`closed`); the machine is `locked`, so commit_transaction returns EK0804 and no further requests are attempted.

Run publication stops at the first rejection: command-log.json contains only ordinal 0 (ignite), state-hashes.json has two rows, final-state.json is the tick-1 snapshot with access still `locked`, and result.json records status rejected with rejection_diagnostic code EK0804.

The genuine prerequisite for `open` is `unlock north_gate with credential/gaoler_key` (the `with <catalog>/<name>` clause is the command-script argument form; without it the resolved argument `{"kind":"none"}` mismatches the compiled credential requirement and yields EK0805). Because the failing script never contains unlock, the run reaches open too early and is rejected.

Content-level repair: insert `unlock north_gate with credential/gaoler_key` before `open north_gate`. The repaired script commits all five requests (tick 5), final state north_gate.access=open, north_gate.ward=unsealed, brazier_02.emission=extinguished, status completed (final hash 3e06b963...).

evidence.finding: north_gate.access machine has initial `locked` and transitions: close only from `open`, open only from `closed`, unlock only from `locked` (input kind `resolved_entity_credential`); north_gate entity credential is `credential/gaoler_key`; north_gate.combustion on_enter(burning) triggers apply_damage(fire, amount=2) on north_gate.integrity.

external command unlock is compiled with requirement {"credential":"credential/gaoler_key","kind":"credential"} (source locked -> target closed), while open is {"kind":"none"} (source closed -> target open); causal edge combustion burning -> integrity apply_damage(2, fire).

status rejected, committed_command_count 1, diagnostics [{"code":"EK0804","message":"`north_gate.access.open` is illegal while the machine is `locked`"}]; first/final hashes fa7247d1.../b40b53f9...

receipt at tick 1 lists exactly two transitions: local command cold->burning (cause ignite) and causal event apply_damage(2,fire) intact->destroyed; the access machine is not transitioned; projection deltas show ground blocker reason `north_gate.portal#blocks_ground` removed while `north_gate.ward#blocks_ground` remains - i.e., ignite changed combustion/integrity and the movement facts, not access.

Run of the script with `unlock north_gate with gaoler_key` is rejected before publication with EK0814 ``gaoler_key` does not match the required shape `<catalog>/<name>``` (repair fix_source_syntax), pinning the accepted command-script argument form to `with <catalog>/<name>` (i.e. `with credential/gaoler_key`).

tick-5 final state: north_gate.access=`open`, north_gate.ward=`unsealed`, brazier_02.emission=`extinguished` (north_gate.combustion `burning`, north_gate.integrity `destroyed` from the retained ignite), demonstrating the repair is complete and consistent with the original script intent.

All six failing.run artifacts reproduced by `nomos run` under the copied packet are SHA-256 identical to the packet's input/failing.run files (result digest 30a0860a70e6f78e6d4843da4e05882883a20793c5d7e5f597b2a91143ad8d78), establishing deterministic reproduction of the rejection.

repair.description: In the `nomos.command_script@1` content, insert the missing prerequisite before `open north_gate`: `unlock north_gate with credential/gaoler_key` (the slot for the entity-bound catalog credential `credential/gaoler_key` required by the compiled unlock command). Sequence becomes: ignite north_gate; unlock north_gate with credential/gaoler_key; open north_gate; unseal north_gate; extinguish brazier_02.
